- walk through deployment from Azure Marketplace listing -> provisioned instance -> sample inference request
- validate service principal / managed identity flow and telemetry to Redwood Console
- exercise fallback routing to the quantized model variant

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Oct 13: 09:30–11:00
- Wed Oct 14: 13:00–14:30
- Thu Oct 15: 08:30–10:00

We have the Stratus engineering leads (Maria Lopez) who can join one slot; please advise your preference.

Pre-run checklist (high level):
- Access: test subscription or sandbox tenant + service principal details (client id/secret or federated identity metadata)
- Infra: confirm region (we'll provision in us-west-2 unless you request otherwise), GPU SKU to reserve (we'll hold 1x A10x or equivalent), and max sequence length for smoke tests
- Artifacts: container image / model artifact location or model name + quantization profile
- Telemetry: ensure we have a telemetry API key + example request for Logs/Console mapping
- Recording: who will host and whether recording is permitted (CloudStride / Redwood / Azure)

If Maria from Stratus needs a short pre-call, we can do a 15-minute blocker check on Mon Oct 12 at 4pm PDT. Otherwise, Tue morning should be fine.

Att: marketplace-checklist.xlsx (stub)
